messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

He who made all things and searches out hidden things in hidden places,","chapter":16,"verse":62},{"text":"surely he knows your imagination, and what you think in your hearts. Woe to those who sin, and try to hide their sin!","chapter":16,"verse":63},{"text":"Because the Lord will exactly investigate all your works, and he will put you all to shame.","chapter":16,"verse":64},{"text":"When your sins are brought out before men, you will be ashamed, and your own iniquities will stand as your accusers in that day.","chapter":16,"verse":65},{"text":"What will you do? Or how will you hide your sins before God and his angels?","chapter":16,"verse":66},{"text":"Behold, God is the judge. Fear him! Stop sinning, and forget your iniquities, to never again commit them. So will God lead you out, and deliver you from all suffering.","chapter":16,"verse":67},{"text":"For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they will take away some of you, and feed you with that which is sacrificed to idols.","chapter":16,"verse":68},{"text":"Those who consent to them will be held in derision and in contempt, and be trodden under foot.","chapter":16,"verse":69},{"text":"For there will be in various places, and in the next cities, a great insurrection against those who fear the Lord.","chapter":16,"verse":70},{"text":"They will be like mad men, sparing none, but spoiling and destroying those who still fear the Lord.","chapter":16,"verse":71},{"text":"For they will destroy and plunder their goods, and throw them out of their houses.","chapter":16,"verse":72},{"text":"Then the trial of my elect will be made known, even as the gold that is tried in the fire.","chapter":16,"verse":73},{"text":"Hear, my elect ones, says the Lord: “Behold, the days of suffering are at hand, and I will deliver you from them.","chapter":16,"verse":74},{"text":"Don’t be afraid, and don’t doubt, for God is your guide.","chapter":16,"verse":75},{"text":"You who keep my commandments and precepts,” says the Lord God, “don’t let your sins weigh you down, and don’t let your iniquities lift themselves up.”","chapter":16,"verse":76},{"text":"Woe to those who are choked with their sins and covered with their iniquities, like a field is choked with bushes, and its path covered with thorns, that no one may travel through!","chapter":16,"verse":77},{"text":"It is shut off and given up to be consumed by fire.","chapter":16,"verse":78}],"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES"}
